headline: Indian markets set to open higher as GIFT Nifty jumps 300 points and oil prices hit two-month lows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: GIFT Nifty jumped 300 points indicating a strong positive opening for the Indian benchmark indices
Brent crude oil prices have slipped below $100 per barrel, reaching a two-month low
The US Democratic win in midterms has led to expectations of lower energy costs and reduced market risk
Sensex and Nifty have extended their winning streak for the fifth consecutive day, reclaiming key technical levels
whatHappening: Indian shares are expected to open higher following a sharp decline in global oil prices and positive US market cues
SEBI has granted approval for the Initial Public Offering (IPO) of Mahanadi Coalfields, a subsidiary of Coal India
Asian markets show mixed performance with the Kospi tumbling 4% due to chipmaker sell-offs while other indices advance
Market analysts are forecasting that the Sensex and Nifty could reach new record highs during the upcoming Samvat 2083
summary: Indian markets are poised for a strong opening today, driven by a 300-point surge in GIFT Nifty and crude oil prices hitting a two-month low. The positive momentum is supported by a five-day winning streak in domestic indices and favorable global cues following the US midterm elections. Key stock-specific news includes SEBI's approval for a Coal India unit's IPO and strong weekly returns for Titan Company.
